# Videomaker

> > Videomaker is a comprehensive resource for video production education, covering cinematography, editing, audio, and equipment reviews for filmmakers at all levels.

Videomaker provides tutorials, buyer's guides, and technical documentation on video production workflows, from pre-production planning through post-production editing. The site features in-depth coverage of editing systems like Avid Xpress DV, audio tools from Sonic Foundry, and production techniques ranging from camera work to special effects.

## Key Topics

- Video Production
- Video Editing
- Post-Production
- Audio Editing
- Cinematography
- Timecode
- Avid Xpress DV
- Special Effects
- Music Videos
- DV Capture
- Shooting Techniques
- Video Equipment Reviews
- Editing Protocols
- Video Storytelling
- Sound Recording

## Production Techniques & Tutorials

- [Master Video Storytelling With The Hollywood Look](https://www.videomaker.com/article/c9/3011-master-video-storytelling-with-the-hollywood-look): Guide to achieving Hollywood-style cinematography and storytelling techniques
- [Camera Work: Shot Language](https://www.videomaker.com/article/c10/1403-camera-work-shot-language): Tutorial on shot terminology and camera shot types for filmmaking basics
- [Honing Your Ideas: From Concept to Finished Treatment](https://www.videomaker.com/article/1615-honing-your-ideas-from-concept-to-finished-treatment): Guide to developing video concepts and writing treatments in preproduction
- [Music in Motion: 15 Steps to Better Music Videos](https://www.videomaker.com/article/f2/1094-music-in-motion-15-steps-to-better-music-videos): 15-step guide to producing better music videos on low budgets
- [Big Bang Exploring The Joy of Explosives](https://www.videomaker.com/article/c4/19920702-big-bang-exploring-the-joy-of-explosives): Guide to using practical explosives and special effects in video production
- [Getting Started: Shooting for the Holidays](https://www.videomaker.com/article/c10/1412-getting-started-shooting-for-the-holidays): Beginner guide to shooting holiday videos for Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas

## Post-Production & Editing

- [Time Code is On Your Side](https://www.videomaker.com/article/f6a/2941-time-code-is-on-your-side): Explanation of timecode basics, drop-frame, and EDL in video editing
- [Editing Protocols](https://www.videomaker.com/article/f6/1537-editing-protocols): Guide to video editing protocols: LANC, Control-M, RS-422, and VISCA
- [Add Audio Compressors to the Mix in Audio Editing](https://www.videomaker.com/article/d2/3044-add-audio-compressors-to-the-mix-in-audio-editing): Tutorial on using audio compressors for dynamic range and mixing control
- [Sound Track: Audio-torium](https://www.videomaker.com/article/c4/3399-sound-track-audio-torium): Tips for recording quality audio in auditoriums and sound-hostile environments
- [Edit Suite: Editing Cameras](https://www.videomaker.com/article/c3/2552-edit-suite-editing-cameras): Overview of in-camera editing and camcorder editing capabilities across formats

## Equipment Reviews & Buyer's Guides

- [Test Bench:Avid Xpress DV 1.5 on IBM Intellistation turnkey editor](https://www.videomaker.com/article/c5/7932-test-benchavid-xpress-dv-15-on-ibm-intellistation-turnkey-editor): Review of Avid Xpress DV 1.5 on IBM Intellistation turnkey editing system
- [Video Equipment Reviews](https://www.videomaker.com/article/1740-video-equipment-reviews): Review of Panasonic AG-456UP S-VHS industrial camcorder
- [Special Effects Generators: Buyer's Guide](https://www.videomaker.com/article/7854-special-effects-generators-buyers-guide): Buyer's guide for video special effects generators and post-production tools
- [Benchmark:Sonic Foundry Acid](https://www.videomaker.com/article/c5/7541-benchmarksonic-foundry-acid): Review of Sonic Foundry Acid loop-based music production software

## Optional

- [Viewfinder: VHS: A Successful Format](https://www.videomaker.com/article/c1/3381-viewfinder-vhs-a-successful-format): Analysis of VHS format longevity and comparison with Super-VHS, Hi8, and DV
- [What is Leased Access?](https://www.videomaker.com/article/n4/520-what-is-leased-access): Explanation of leased access for cable television and FCC regulations
